newsitem.title: JAPAN: Indonesia firm plans 10 bln yen samurai-sources.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia firm plans 10 bln yen samurai-sources.

text.p: A unit of Indonesia's PT Dharmala Intiutama (DIU) plans to launch about 10 billion yen worth of five-year samurai bonds this week at earliest, underwriting sources said on Tuesday.
The bonds will be issued through the Netherlands-based unit, Dharmala Intiutama International BV. The bonds are expected to be guaranteed by DIU, they said.
The bonds will be lead-managed by Yamaichi Securities.
"The bonds could be launched this week at the earliest," an underwriter said.
The bonds to be issued by the unit received a preliminary rating of triple B minus (BBB-) from Nippon Investors Service (NIS) on June 6.
